name: Story film
feel: Quiet and human: one person, one small want, a held moment of near-silence, then a turn that lands with the music. The product arrives late and helps.
transitions: hard cuts on musical phrases; one fade from or to black at most
rules: Write a one-line logline first: one person, one want, one obstacle.
Setup in the first fifth, friction to about 60%, a held near-silent beat, the turn at 65-80%, brand last.
Cut on the music's 4- or 8-bar phrases, not on every beat.
Real people are filmed, not generated; generated shots are for places and objects and get the AI label.
